author: GameTrailers
description: Get a closer look at gameplay and more from GodsTV in this trailer for the upcoming 90s-inspired action roguelite steeped in showbiz parody. Players shoot and slice through fast-paced runs, farm aura, shape their fighting style, and earn the Gods’ favor on their way to Godhood. GodsTV will be available on PC via Steam Early Access in 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: GodsTV - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Quality Update Trailer for Daisen, a first-person, fast-paced action shooter developed by Loyal Studio. Players must shoot to heal in this high-tension shooter as Emilia. Make use of a suite of weapons alongside a new quality update in Daisen, available now for PC (Steam).
title: Daisen - Official Quality Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Cyclops ‘Elegant Eye’ Costume Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit free-to-play third-person team hero shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players can dominate the opposition in style with Cyclops' new ‘Elegant Eye’ Costume, first seen in X-Men (2021) #12. Suit up with the ‘Elegant Eye’ Costume for Marvel Rivals, launching on August 20 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Cyclops ‘Elegant Eye’ Costume Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Super Glitch Dash, a rhythm-based first-person runner developed by David Marquardt Studios. Players will overcome obstacles to the beat of the music across abstract worlds. Progress through a suite of levels in Super Glitch Dash, launching on September 9 for PC (Steam).
title: Super Glitch Dash - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Early Access Release Date Announcement Trailer for Bot Slash Bot, a fast-paced action hack-and-slash arcade game developed by Traveller's Box. Players will embody a rogue robot ready to slice and dice the machines that once held them captive. Stay mobile and dispatch enemies before time runs out in Bot Slash Bot, launching into Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: Bot Slash Bot - Official Early Access Release Date Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Launch Trailer for Pit Panic, an action roguelike platformer developed by Flying Rat Studio. Players will dig their own path to escape a sinking Aztec Temple. Collect loot, wield god-like powers, and climb the daily leaderboards. Pit Panic is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam, GoG, and Epic Games Store).
title: Pit Panic - Official Gameplay Launch Trailer

description:

description: Watch the Daredevil ‘Attorney at Law’ Costume Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit third-person team-based hero shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players can enact the court of law with the ‘Attorney at Law’ Costume, first seen in Daredevil (2014) #14. Lay down the law with Daredevil's ‘Attorney at Law’ Costume in Marvel Rivals, launching on August 20 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Daredevil ‘Attorney at Law’ Costume Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join XBOX for the world's biggest video game convention. Can’t make it to Cologne? Were bringing the show to you with two days of live broadcasts directly from the heart of the XBOX booth.

This is Day 1 of our two-day broadcast from gamescom 2026, and we’re kicking things off with a packed show featuring interviews, special guests, first-look gameplay reveals, new trailers, and more.

The show kicks off Wednesday, August 26, at 7am PDT / 10am EDT / 3pm BST / 4pm CEST, as we go live with a closer look at some of the biggest games coming to XBOX. 

Day 1 features Minecraft Dungeons II, Forza Horizon 6, Gears of War: E-Day, Fable and much more.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
title: XBOX @ gamescom Broadcast 2026 | Day 1

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a Reveal Trailer for Precinct IX, a pixel-based cyberpunk visual novel developed by ZataForge Studio. Players will manage the operations of a cyberpunk police station by managing cases, negotiating terms, and upgrading equipment. Uncover a deep truth in Precinct IX, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Precinct IX - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at 'The Legend of the Onimusha' Trailer for Onimusha: Way of the Sword, an upcoming third-person action game developed by Capcom. Players can hear the legendary tale of The Legend of Onimusha, a legendary story told to every samurai in training. Get the rundown on the history of the Oni, Genma, and Onimusha in Onimusha: Way of the Sword, launching on September 4 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Xbox on PC, Steam, and Epic Games Store).
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Official 'The Legend of the Onimusha' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the PS5 Launch Trailer for Birds Watching, a first-person psychological horror game developed by Studio Ortica. Players will engage in the serene activity of bird watching after an endless fire destroys the world. Explore the mountains and seek their aid in Birds Watching, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Birds Watching - Official PS5 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Project P.I.T.T is available now on Steam. Watch the chaotic Project P.I.T.T launch trailer for this incremental physics automation sandbox where you build chaotic production lines, hit corporate targets, chain colossal combos, and feed products into a growing bottomless pit.
title: Project P.I.T.T - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for The Deep Waits, a pixel-based survival crafting game developed by Kogren Studio. Players will have a mere one minute of time to eat, fight, and craft a way off the island before certain doom. Evade becoming one with The Deep in The Deep Waits, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The Deep Waits - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Explore the vibrant sci-fi planet of Honeycomb: The World Beyond in this trailer for the upcoming survival sandbox game developed by Frozen Way. Meet strange creatures, check out gameplay, and learn about your mission in this new trailer. Honeycomb: The World Beyond will be available on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on September 8, 2026. A demo will be available on Steam on August 31, 2026.

In Honeycomb: The World Beyond, step into the astro boots of Hennessy, a pioneer forging an expedition on an uninhabited, mysterious planet that could be the key to saving mankind. Explore the world of Sota7 and uncover its secrets. From calm forests and vibrant jungles to vast fields spread at the foot of a mysterious volcano, every trek through its diverse terrain is sure to leave a lasting impression. Carve out a home for yourself and use that safe space to further your research. Honeycomb: The World Beyond was developed with NVIDIA features integrated into the experience, suc
title: Honeycomb: The World Beyond - Official New Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Launch Trailer for Tic-Tac: Twelve O'Clock, a first-person action horror game developed by ARMAG. Players will stand on guard against the horrors in Bluebird High School. Look over surveillance, maintain the generator, and don't get seen in the process. Tic-Tac: Twelve O'Clock is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Tic-Tac: Twelve O'Clock - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Planet Harvester: Incremental Odyssey is available now on PC via Steam. Watch the Planet Harvester: Incremental Odyssey launch trailer for this relaxing low-poly incremental game. Pilot your crawler across beautiful worlds, chew through resources, unlock new tools, hire drones, and customize your machine for ever bigger hauls. Turn small numbers into massive ones!
title: Planet Harvester: Incremental Odyssey - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Ministry of Truth: False Memory, a narrative-driven adventure simulation game developed by IKKOSAMA and False Memory Dept. Players explore the inside of a totalitarian society to change facts, make up history, and ensure the general public gets the truth. Ministry of Truth: False Memory is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Ministry of Truth: False Memory - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The new Runeomicon trailer showcases gameplay and a release date. Check out the latest Runeomicon trailer for this upcoming dark fantasy tower-defense game where players perform an unholy ritual with their own hands by drawing runes in real time to summon ancient gods and, ultimately, the Goddess of Death. Runeomicon will be available on PC via Steam on September 16, 2026.
title: Runeomicon - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Hunting Simulator 3 will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC on October 29, 2026. Check out the Hunting Simulator 3 release date trailer for this upcoming sim game, where you'll explore the landscapes of Colorado and Texas. In Hunting Simulator 3, play either solo or alongside your loyal hunting dog, as you track 35 different animal species using a wide range of gear from leading hunting brands.
title: Hunting Simulator 3 - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Buddy System Update Trailer for Subnautica 2, the aquatic action-adventure game developed by Unknown Worlds Entertainment. Players can now access the latest update with the all-new Buddy System, where they can invite friends to dive back into Proteus' waters with a new Proximity Chat feature, along with Player Trading, Revives, and all-new Tracking Tags. Dive into uncharted waters with friends in Subnautica 2, available now in Early Access for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam).
title: Subnautica 2 - Official Buddy System Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Resort Island Simulator, an island resort management simulator developed by Tenjin Games. Players will manage the goings-on of a sprawling island to establish a bustling resort empire. Seek out treasures, unlock new areas, and seek out new opportunities for the resort. Resort Island Simulator is launching on August 28 for PC (Steam).
title: Resort Island Simulator - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Vision: Lightning Trailer for Final Fantasy Resonance, an upcoming HD-2D turn-based RPG developed by Square Enix. Players can look within and summon the might of Lightning to make use of her lightning-based abilities in battle. Shock the opposition in Final Fantasy Resonance, launching on October 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Final Fantasy Resonance - Official Vision: Lightning Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Learn about your objectives and get a closer look at gameplay from Car Park Capital in this trailer for the upcoming satirical strategy and management simulation. Car Park Capital is about transforming perfectly functional towns into car-dependent automotive paradises. In Car Park Capital, you've been hired by Big Auto to unleash the Freedom of Car Dependency on unsuspecting townsfolk. Buy land, demolish homes, build vast parking facilities, drill for oil, manufacture cars, satisfy your citizens' increasingly automotive needs, and use propaganda to ensure everyone understands that this is progress. Car Park Capital will be available in Early Access on PC via Steam on October 9, 2026.
title: Car Park Capital - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Story Trailer for Barkour, a fast-paced stealth action platformer developed by Varsav Game Studios. Players will embody Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R., a special canine agent who's ready for anything from mission to mission. Traverse a diverse set of locations on high-stakes missions, overcome challenges with a suite of gadgets, and dispatch enemies to save the world. Take a look at the game's story for Barkour, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Barkour - Official Story Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Hack 'n' Stack, a physics-based tower defense party game developed by Triple Boris Inc. and Dodo Tako. Players will join forces with friends to build barricades, place turrets, and defend the Kingdom by any means necessary. Hack 'n' Stack is launching on September 24 for Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam).
title: Hack 'n' Stack - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a fresh look at gameplay from Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival in this brutal new trailer for the upcoming survival-horror action game. The new trailer also showcases a collection of in-game items and deadly weapons in action from the Deluxe Edition of Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival, along with pre-order bonuses. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and Nintendo Switch 2 on October 8, 2026.

Embark on a battle for survival against Hell’s armies with a terrifying new story in the Hellraiser universe in Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival. Descend into the darkest depths of the underworld to rescue your love from the depraved clutches of the Cenobites. Face your deepest fears against deviant wretches, cultists and creatures with the infernal powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box and an arsenal of earthly weapons.
title: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: See the bosses you'll face and get another look at gameplay from Mexican Ninja in this launch trailer for the upcoming 2.5D roguelike beat ’em up game. Become the Mexican Ninja and fight to take back Nuevo Tokyo, where Narcos and Yakuzas have fused into the ruthless Narkuzas. Master slick combos, unleash outrageous Mexican Jutsus and craft deadly builds. Mexican Ninja will be available on PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and Xbox One on August 20, 2026.
title: Mexican Ninja - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Work together to rebuild Felicia Bay's public transport network! Watch the latest Bus Simulator 27 trailer for this bus-driving simulation game to see how the cooperative multiplayer mode works. Bus Simulator 27 will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on September 8, 2026.

In Bus Simulator 27, once the company is up and running, the team can take to the roads of Felicia Bay. Players can operate the same route together or independently take charge of different lines. They can also join another player’s bus to assist with tasks such as checking passengers’ tickets. Thanks to cross-platform play, players can run their bus company together across all supported platforms.
title: Bus Simulator 27 - Official Multiplayer Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Golden Swirl, a dark fantasy action-based card battler developed by Snako Production. Players will survive the life-and-death struggle of a melancholic realm by mastering the game's tactical movement. Build a powerful deck, find formidable relics, and strategically think about the road ahead. Golden Swirl is launching on September 9 for PC (Steam).
title: Golden Swirl - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the August Update 1.17 Trailer for Gran Turismo 7, the hit racing simulation game developed by Polyphony Digital. Players can enjoy new content with the latest 1.71 update, packed with three new World Circuits, Whistler added as featured Curation in Scapes, and four new cars, including the 2025 Hyundai Ioniq 6 N, 1997 Toyota Mark 2 Tourer V, 1997 Toyota Chaser Tourer V, and the 2008 Caterham Seven Superlight R500. Update 1.17 for Gran Turismo 7 is launching on August 19 at 11 PM PT on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2), and PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Gran Turismo 7 - Official August Update 1.17 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Katuba's Poacher, a 2D stylized action boss rush roguelike developed by Joe Yu. Players will take on boss after boss in a cartoon-style world to land hits to the beat of fast-paced jazz. Seek out new weapons, take out monsters, and recognize hit patterns to reign victorious. Katuba's Poacher is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Katuba's Poacher - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Weapons free! Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer gets its first dedicated deep-dive trailer. Boasting all new Apex Attachments, allowing each gun a unique attachment slot that allows them to fill a specific niche. The new Kill Block mode changes the map across each round of play, meaning you'll never breach and clear the same situation twice! 
Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23rd for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (BattleNet, Steam, Xbox on PC), and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 - Official Multiplayer Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Tour the world of The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline in this latest trailer for the upcoming first-person psychological mystery thriller and story-driven adventure that reinterprets Dante Alighieri's The Divine Comedy as a surreal, introspective experience. The new trailer gives a peek at puzzles, gameplay, and a release date. The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on September 10, 2026. It will also be available on Nintendo Switch 2 at a later date in 2026.

The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.
title: The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Baptiste in this unsettling new trailer for the upcoming story-driven psychological horror game developed by Digital Dreams and Firenut Games. Devastated by a family tragedy, Sara and her son, Tom, seek a new start at Jagged Shore Cliff in Baptiste. However, their worst fear is waiting for them there. Baptiste will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Baptiste - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join Oni Lady (voiced by Yuriri Naka) for a deeper dive into Onimusha: Way of the Sword in this latest trailer for the upcoming action game. The new trailer spotlights Sasaki Ganryu, as you learn about Musashi's rival. Sasaki Ganryu is a skilled swordsman who seeks to do battle with Musashi. Both men come into possession of an Oni Gauntlet, but Ganryu pursues a darker path. 

Onimusha: Way of the Sword will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) on September 4, 2026.
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Official Onimusha Curious Cases: Sasaki Ganryu Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this new trailer for Hell Rising, the new DLC for Team Ninja's action Soulslike RPG, Nioh 3! Visit the Keian Era of Edo in 1651 and battle Yokai, Bandits and Alchemists from lands far away. Wield new Guardian Spirits and weaponry, while augmenting your build with all new armor sets, Ninjitsu, Samurai Skills, Onmyo Magic and more! 
Nioh 3 Hell Rising DLC Vol.1 is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Nioh 3 - Official Hell Rising DLC Vol.1 Launch Trailer
